milestone: Checked immutable CPU tensor scalar indexing

implementation.syntax: Postfix tensor[index,...], one per dimension; tensor[] for rank zero
implementation.lowering: Shared CPU MLIR tensor.extract for array and tensor reads, after evaluating all operands, checked extent/byte count and per-axis unsigned i64 bounds comparisons
implementation.fault: Private code 5 and BoundsFault retained; FaultKind.Bounds now uses generic bounded static message index out of bounds
implementation.continuations: Operand collection, kernel parameters and imported helper/callback remapping preserve all index operands; awaited index expressions are supported

contract.rank: One integer per dimension; zero for rank zero; missing/extra axes diagnosed
contract.range: 0 <= index[axis] < extent[axis]; no negative indexing, wrapping, truncation, slicing or mutation
contract.evaluation: Tensor then each index, once each, before validation; operand failures retain original locations; known invalid bounds diagnosed statically
contract.placement: Completed CPU tensors only; host lookup of resident GPU data rejected; explicit CPU transfer accepted by placement-aware frontend; GPU kernel lookup remains disabled

scope: Frontend: all six element types and four integer index types at ranks 0,1,2,3,8; malformed IR, known bounds, rank/type/residency errors and explicit CPU transfer gate
32 runtime helpers per variant: six matrix element types with signed64/unsigned64/mixed32 index signatures, plus int64/float32 ranks 0,1,3,8
Exact bits including signed zeros, subnormals and NaN payloads, eight ARM FP states, row/column-major strided layouts and negative strides
Empty dimensions on each axis, maximal/negative indices, invalid descriptor extent/byte metadata, pre-entry cancellation and no read allocations
Captured tensors in numeric maps, mixed-width index captures, nested workers, awaited tensor/indices, rank-zero/rank-three workers and tensors read after group settlement
Cached scalar results, row/column Bounds failures and exhaustive FaultKind recovery; 1/2/4-worker success/cancellation/deadline/admission and core/invocation allocation failures
Operand fault ordering: first/second index faults, negative row with failing column and failing tensor input all preserve first executed fault
Invalid source preserves existing output artifacts; all four array-index runtime regressions and frontend/source/storage/numeric/control/selected GPU regressions passed
Focused qualification, not a full-suite claim

remaining_gates: Slicing and sub-tensor views, immutable element replacement
